title: warn unsaved
name: Warn unsaved — Vercel
rule: Warn before navigation that would lose unsaved changes.
pass_when: Leaving with unsaved changes prompts a warning.
fail_when: Navigation discards unsaved values with no warning.
overview: Warn before navigation that would discard unsaved form changes.
apply_when: Leaving a form or step with dirty unsaved values.
not_when: Saved or pristine forms where navigation loses nothing.
agent_hint: Prompt before leave when unsaved changes would be discarded.
description: Warn before navigation that would lose unsaved changes. Pass when leaving with unsaved changes prompts a warning; fail when navigation discards unsaved values with no warning. The warning protects against accidental data loss on leave without inventing auto-save behavior this row does not require. Apply when the form is dirty; skip when nothing would be lost.
